contract_text: [CUSTOMER] Amendment No. 2 to Cloud Services Agreement. Amendment Effective Date: January 1, 2027. The parties leave the service term unchanged; the agreement expires December 31, 2027 and automatically renews for successive one-year terms unless written notice is given at least 90 days before expiration. Supplier must report any actual or suspected security incident involving Customer Data within 48 hours.
